_post.post_content: Lilavati Hospital is transforming its healthcare operations by collaborating with Healthray, a comprehensive digital platform that eliminates major inefficiencies and elevates the patient experience.
_post.post_title: Lilavati Hospital’s Path to Modern Healthcare: Leveraging Healthray for Operational Success

fields.quote_text: “Healthray training has strengthened the confidence of every staff member. We can now manage all the departments in just one click.”

solutions.title: Cost Saving
solutions.text: After adopting Healthray cloud infrastructure, Lilavati Hospital has witnessed remarkable improvements in operational and financial performance. Lilavati has lessened additional expenses on server maintenance or IT staffing. There is a noticeable improvement in administrative efficiency.

solutions.title: Assistance in Training
solutions.text: Healthray specialists performed detailed assessments of all department workflows to deeply understand their existing challenges and design digital modules based on that. Hospital legacy data got securely migrated to the Healthray cloud system, ensuring a smooth transition without any data loss.

solutions.title: Integration for Coordinated Care
solutions.text: The Healthray interoperable system has integrated all the different departments of Lilavati Hospital into a single, unified, connected network. With Healthray, the pharmacy department can easily view digital prescriptions from doctors. Lab technicians can automatically receive test order notifications.

solutions.title: Enhanced Patient Communication and Accessibility
solutions.text: After adopting Healthray, Lilavati Hospital has improved patient communication and accessibility. They got measurable results: 30% faster consultations with AI suggestions and auto-fill, expanded telemedicine coverage throughout India, 70% EHR adoption within just 3 months and 40% fewer no-shows through automated reminders.
